summary: The root هبو (hbw) describes ashes becoming mixed with dust and extinguishing. It also refers to embers dying out.
lane: 1 هَباَ الرَّمَادُ ذ , (JK, TA,) aor. يَهْبُو , (TA,) The ashes became mixed with dust, and extinguished: (JK, TA:) and هَباَ الجَمْرُ . (M, art. رمد .)
